packsize.note: When gramasi is a numeric size, packsize = '<gramasi> <satuan>' (e.g. '30 ml'). When gramasi is a non-numeric literal such as 'Multi Variant' or 'Set', packsize equals gramasi verbatim and satuan is set to 'Multi Variant' / 'Set' respectively. For bundle_type='multipack', packsize = '<gramasi> <satuan> x <int(bundle_quantity)> pcs' (e.g. '15 ml x 2 pcs').

sku_type_complete.note: sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Skintific 5X Ceramide Serum'), so brand is NOT concatenated again.

keywords.note: keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type_complete in 98.8% of existing rows.
